question: Consider a graph of Stopping Potential ($V_0$) versus Frequency ($\nu$) for a photosensitive metal. If the experiment is repeated with a different metal having a higher work function, how will the new graph compare to the original one?

options.A: The new line will have a steeper slope
options.B: The new line will be parallel but shifted to the right (higher threshold frequency)
options.C: The new line will be parallel but shifted to the left (lower threshold frequency)
options.D: The new line will pass through the origin
